family.schneider-d48620.description: The 20 MHz 486SX in Schneider’s Business line.
family.schneider-d48620.history: Schneider introduced the D486/20 in November 1991 for its Business line, with MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.0. IFS advertised three desktop designations in Portugal in May 1992. In July 1992, the German price list offered the 120 MB D486/20 for DM 4,377 net and the 200 MB version for DM 4,815.
